AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Adoption Upon Second Reading of Ordinance No. 20-743 Amending Chapter 8.56 (Smoking Prohibited) and Section 18.12.030 (Prohibited Uses) of Chapter 18.12 (C Zone) of the City’s Municipal Code Regulating Electronic Cigarettes, Vaporizers, Pods, and Liquids Used to Inhale any Substance
Recommendation: That the City Council adopt by title only, upon second reading, Ordinance No. O20-743 amending Chapter 8.56 (Smoking Prohibited) and Section 18.12.030 (Prohibited Uses) of Chapter 18.12 (C Zone) of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code regulating electronic cigarettes, vaporizers, pods, and liquids used to inhale any substance as presented.

Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
7.
Public Hearing – Request to Appeal Planning Commission Denial of M-1360-19; Miscellaneous Application for a Request for a Nonstandard Driveway within City Right-of-Way at the Single-Family Residence Located at 744 Cloyden Road (Lot 16, Block 1276, Tract 7140) (Resolution No. PCR-2020-1161) (This Project is Exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.) Appellant, Applicant, &
Owner: Dale Sanchez, 744 Cloyden Road, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommendation: That the City Council uphold the Planning Commission’s decision to deny the nonstandard driveway. Should City Council reverse the Planning Commission’s decision, staff recommends adding a condition that the applicant execute a license agreement with the City for the nonstandard encroachment.
Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
8.
Update and Discussion of the Activities of the Pension Ad Hoc Committee and the Police Ad Hoc Committee
Recommendation: That the City Council receive updates from the Council Ad Hoc Committees, discuss the status of their work, and provide any direction Council deems appropriate.
Staff Report
9.
Consideration of the Withdrawal of Claim for the Difference in Back Rent from the PV Homes Association due to the City of Palos Verdes Estates
Recommendation: That the City Council provide direction as to the withdrawal of this claim for the difference in back rent and further discussion and analysis of the original lease agreement.
Staff Report
10.
Request to Amend License Agreement with Lunada Bay Little League and Palos Verdes Little League for Use of George Allen Field to Delete the Requirement for Payment of Utilities and Waive Past and Future Utility Costs Recommendation: That City Council consider options and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
11.
Calendar for Preparation of the 2020-2021 Annual Budget
Recommendation: That the City Council “receive and file” this report that presents the calendar for preparation of the Fiscal Year 2020-2021 annual budget, and advise of changes.
Staff Report
